## Install or update

Open Terminal and paste:

```
bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mmzeller/nameplate/main/install.sh)
```

That puts Nameplate in Applications and starts it. Run the same line again any time to update.

**Prefer clicking?** Download **Nameplate.dmg** below, open it, and drag Nameplate into Applications. The first time you open it, macOS says it can't verify the app (it isn't signed with a paid Apple developer certificate). Click **Done**, open **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**. You only need to do that once per download.

Works on Apple silicon and Intel Macs with macOS 13 Ventura or newer.
